WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.striker,
        bb.non_striker,
        bb.over_id,
        bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bb.non_striker IS NOT NULL
),
ordered_balls AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as ball_seq
    FROM ball_data
),
-- Use the full pair (striker, non_striker) to detect changes
partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        ball_seq,
        ball_id,
        striker,
        non_striker,
        runs_scored,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) as p_min,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as p_max,
        (striker || ',' || non_striker) as pair_key,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(pair_key) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY ball_seq) IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN LAG(pair_key) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY ball_seq) != pair_key THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_new_partnership
    FROM ordered_balls
),
-- Assign partnership IDs
partnership_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        ball_seq,
        ball_id,
        striker,
        non_striker,
        runs_scored,
        p_min,
        p_max,
        SUM(is_new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY ball_seq) as partnership_id
    FROM partnerships
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        partnership_id,
        p_min as p_min,
        p_max as p_max,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = p_min THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) as p_min_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = p_max THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) as p_max_runs,
        SUM(runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM partnership_ids
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, partnership_id, p_min, p_max
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_partnership_runs
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
-- Get all partnerships that have the max runs for their match
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        p.match_id,
        p.innings_no,
        p.p_min,
        p.p_max,
        p.p_min_runs,
        p.p_max_runs,
        p.partnership_runs,
        -- Determine player1: higher runs, or if equal, higher ID
        CASE 
            WHEN p.p_max_runs > p.p_min_runs THEN p.p_max
            WHEN p.p_max_runs < p.p_min_runs THEN p.p_min
            ELSE GREATEST(p.p_min, p.p_max)
        END as player1,
        -- Determine player2: lower runs, or if equal, lower ID
        CASE 
            WHEN p.p_max_runs > p.p_min_runs THEN p.p_min
            WHEN p.p_max_runs < p.p_min_runs THEN p.p_max
            ELSE LEAST(p.p_min, p.p_max)
        END as player2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.match_id, p.innings_no 
            ORDER BY p.p_max_runs DESC, p.p_min_runs DESC, p.p_min ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM player_runs p
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_partnership_runs
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    player1,
    player2,
    p_max_runs,
    p_min_runs,
    partnership_runs
FROM max_partnerships
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY match_id, innings_no
LIMIT 100
